bearer.description: A key from POST /v1/signup, or a scoped key from POST /v1/keys.

x-errors.message: Send your key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Get a key from POST /v1/signup.
Use a relative path like reports/run.html, with no empty, . or .. parts.
Send x-sha256: the file's sha256 as 64 lowercase hex characters, as `sha256sum <file>` prints it.
The bytes received do not match x-sha256. Hash the file again and retry.
Send JSON { files: [{ path, sha256, size }] } with at most 1000 files.
Send JSON { from, to }: two folders, neither inside the other.
Send JSON { from, to }: two files, or two folders ending in /, neither inside the other.
Send JSON { name, prefix }: a name of 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, and an optional folder.
Send JSON { capBytes } between 0 and maxCapBytes from GET /v1/limits.
Send JSON { message } with 1 to 2000 characters.
This account reached its storage cap. Delete files, or raise the cap with PUT /v1/limits.
Your free 10 GB is full across your accounts. Delete files to make room.
Too much feedback for now. Send it again after retryAfter seconds.
The file changed since you read it. List it again, then retry with its current sha256 in If-Match.
This key can't do that here. Ask for a key with the folder and permission you need.
This key expired. Ask for a new one.
This Idempotency-Key was used for a different request. Use a new key.
A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry after retryAfter seconds.
Send an Idempotency-Key of 1 to 128 characters.
A file is at this path. Move or delete it first.
This file was taken down after an abuse report.
Send JSON { prefix, permissions, ttlSeconds }: a folder ending in / or empty, a non-empty list of read, write or delete, and optionally 60 to 31536000 seconds.
Send a ttl of 60 to 31536000 seconds in x-agentfs-ttl, or ttlSeconds in a batch entry.
Send JSON { url, reason }: the link and why it should come down.
Send ?by=agent, ?by=session or ?by=commit.
Too many reports from this address. Retry after retryAfter seconds.
Use a key of 1 to 512 letters, digits, dots, colons, @, / or -, and send a JSON body.
Send at most 64 KB of JSON.
Send JSON { op: "tool", name, status: "ok" or "error", input, output, durationMs, startedAt }, with at most 64 KB each in input and output.
Nothing is here.
No snapshot has this name. List them with GET /v1/snapshots.
A snapshot with this name exists. Pick another name, or delete it first.
This key was rotated, or its unclaimed account expired. Use your newest key, or sign up again.
Too many signups from this address. Retry after retryAfter seconds.
This claim link is wrong or expired. Ask the agent for a new one: `agentfs claim`.
GitHub sign-in did not finish. Open the claim link again.
Someone else already claimed this account.
Start with JSON { path, sha256, size }, PUT each part to /v1/uploads/<upload>/<uploadId>/<part>, then POST { path, sha256, parts } to .../complete.
This upload failed or no longer exists. Start a new one with POST /v1/uploads.
The stored bytes do not match the size or sha256 this upload started with. Upload it again.
Send a Content-Length header. For a stream of unknown length, use POST /v1/uploads.
Something failed on our side. Retry, and if it keeps failing, send feedback.
